review.official:
Durin serves on
Rhodes Island
Op Reserve Team A4
.
She has a tremendous aptitude for
Arts
but is unable to fully realize her potential due to her physiology.
Extremely narcoleptic, she is able to fall asleep at just about any place or time despite averaging more hours of sleep than most
operators
. Despite this, she makes very few mistakes in her work.

files.description:
Radiological exam scan showed clear outlines of internal organs with no abnormality detected. Originium Particle Test of the circulation system indicated no Oripathy. The subject is confirmed as non-infected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Durin showed no signs of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.18u/L
Operator Durin has come into frequent contact with processed Originium, but so far no abnormalities have been detected.

Modus Operandi: She takes advantage of her small stature to launch surprise attacks. 
SOP: She finds somewhere more comfortable to sleep.

Thanks to her peculiar origins, Durin eats a slightly different diet than most operators, though this does not mean she eats any less. Despite her small stature, she is known to wolf down an entire meal before her fellow operators have taken more than a few bites. She then promptly seeks out a place to sleep.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Morning, Doctor... Mind if I lay out my sleeping bag here...? Thanks. The rest is up to you...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: How do I fight? Using Arts, of course... Want me to show you the power of earth?

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: What time is it...? See, I don't work mornings, noons, afternoons, or nights...

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You'll make an S-sized uniform for me...? No thanks. My oversized one works as a sheet when I take naps... plus, it's really warm.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Dooooctoooooor? I need a break! I'm competing in the Speedy Sleep Contest.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, check this out. This isn't my normal wand, it's a pendulum. You're feeling very sleepy and will nap in five minutes without giving me any work... Zzzz...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I was hoping I could tell you about my homeland, Doctor.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: After you went to sleep, I somehow didn't feel sleepy at all anymore... Hmmmph...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hello? Hellooooo? Can you hear me? Down here. Down heeeeere! Nice meeting you, big Doctor. I'm Durin the Caster.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Whoa... I've fiiiinally gotten s-tron-ger.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: The secret to staying healthy is to sleep whenever you can.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Captain's orders: everyone, save your energy and take a nap!

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I wanna dig a hole in the ground and make a shelter to sleep in, if you don't mind.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Take over for me. Thaaanks.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Wooo.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: What a pain.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Okaaaay, I'll do it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: You're going down!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Gooooooo!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Why do we have annoying missions like this? Can't we do something easier...? Still, it's nice that we won.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Of course we won. I worked real hard supporting you with my Arts.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, are you still worried about those ones that got through?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ugghh... Sorry... I'll try harder next time...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: The Land of Giants... Here I aaaaaaaaaaaaaaam!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmmm?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I'm in a good mood, so how about a magic trick?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Big Doctor. There's lots of tasty foods at the cafeteria. Have you been eating well? Oh, right, I saw Myrtle carrying a huge sack with her to the cafeteria just now. Too late, though. I already ate all the cheese fried fowlbeast.

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: *Yawn*... Good morning...

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Big Doctor, Big Doctor, Happy birthday! If you're another year older, does that mean you're getting taller, too? I bought you a sleeping bag. If you're getting taller, I don't know how long it'll fit...?

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Because of how short I am, nobody ever notices whether I'm working or playing hooky... Rhodes Island gave me a really comfortable environment to sleep in, though, so I still gotta do some things every now and then to repay the favor. Doctor, I'm looking forward to a good year.
